name: Don't Steal the Baby Brainrots
desc:
Welcome to Don’t Steal the Baby Brainrots!

How to Play:
- Sneak in and take Baby Brainrots when they sleep 😴
- Run away when they wake up to chase you 🏃‍♂️
- Stay alive and collect many Baby Brainrots ⚡
- Upgrade your character and get more cash 💸
- Trade or gift your characters with friends and grow together 🎁

Shhh… Don’t wake the Brainrots 🤫

Your Baby Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE 💤

Like the game and join the group for FREE Reward 👍
